title: Goldfish eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='water' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1b3a5c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0d1f33'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- water glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='46' ry='38' fill='url(#water)'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#7fd4ff' opacity='0.75'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='14' r='2.2' fill='#b3e6ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='16' r='1.6' fill='#b3e6ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 52 Q14 38 10 44 Q18 52 10 60 Q14 66 30 52 Z' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <path d='M30 52 Q18 46 14 50 Q20 52 15 56 Q20 58 30 52 Z' fill='#ffc285'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='52' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#ff9b2f'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='58' rx='22' ry='11' fill='#ffc06a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- scales hint -->
  <path d='M46 46 Q50 44 54 46' stroke='#ffe0a8' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 42 Q56 40 60 42' stroke='#ffe0a8' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 50 Q60 48 64 50' stroke='#ffe0a8' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M44 35 Q54 26 66 34 Q56 36 44 35 Z' fill='#ff7a1f'/>
  <!-- belly fin -->
  <path d='M50 68 Q58 76 66 68 Q58 66 50 68 Z' fill='#ff7a1f'/>
  <!-- gill line -->
  <path d='M40 42 Q37 52 40 62' stroke='#ffd18c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='47' r='5.5' fill='#fff5e0'/>
  <circle cx='65.5' cy='47' r='3' fill='#20304a'/>
  <circle cx='66.5' cy='45.8' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- mouth open -->
  <path d='M77 52 Q82 50 80 56 Q77 55 77 52 Z' fill='#c94a10'/>
  <!-- snack pellet -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='54' r='4.5' fill='#8bdc5a'/>
  <circle cx='84.5' cy='52.5' r='1.5' fill='#ccf5a8'/>
  <!-- crumb -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='60' r='1.3' fill='#8bdc5a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little sparkle -->
  <path d='M24 30 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 z' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
